title: Apartment Interior Design 60 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 60 m² apartment with 18 m² terrace: interior design and 3D visualization. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Interior design of an apartment with a terrace, 60 m²

blocks.text: Interior design of an apartment with a terrace, 60 m²

parts.html: An interior design project for a 60 m² apartment with an 18 m² terrace: the studio developed the layout, selected the materials, and produced photorealistic 3D visualizations of every room. The interior is contemporary, in a calm palette of light oak, gray stone and concrete, and black metal.

According to the measured floor plan, the apartment has a 22.6 m² kitchen-living room, a 10.2 m² bedroom, a 4.7 m² hallway, and a 3.8 m² bathroom. The terrace runs along the facade, and the windows of the kitchen-living room and the bedroom face onto it.

The kitchen and living room are one space. The kitchen stands against the wall: tall pantry units with a built-in oven at the ends, and the sink and cooktop between them. In front of the kitchen is an island clad in gray stone, with a wooden dining table attached to it. Opposite is the TV area: a wall of large concrete-look slabs, a low media unit on black legs, and a niche with open shelves and vertical lighting.

The floors in the rooms are light oak in a chevron pattern, and the entrance hall has large gray tiles. The kitchen’s tall units are finished in oak, the upper cabinets are light gray, matte, and handleless, and the backsplash is a stone-look slab. A black track with linear lights runs along the ceiling, and above the table hangs a fixture of thin black rods with shades. The flush-mounted doors sit level with the wall, and by the entrance the wall is made of gray panels and an oak inset with a long black handle.
The bedroom has gray-beige walls, a bed with an upholstered gray headboard, and dark floor-length curtains. A built-in workspace runs along one wall: a desktop, a shelf, and a light wood panel.

The bathroom is tiled from floor to ceiling in gray stone-look tile. There is a wall-hung toilet with floor-to-ceiling cabinets with wooden fronts above it. The faucet, bidet shower, and towel warmer are black; a gray countertop basin sits on a wooden vanity, with an oval mirror in a black frame above it.

The terrace works as an outdoor living room: wooden decking, a large light gray modular sofa with a built-in side table, and a wooden slat screen with ivy climbing over it. The cost of a project like this depends on the floor area and the scope of work; see design package prices for details.
